cards.title: Add your baby to health insurance (after birth)
cards.body: You are likely eligible to add your baby to your health insurance outside the usual sign-up period, but only for a short time. Going by your due date, plan to do this by about 2027-01-06. The date moves if your baby arrives early or late.

cards.title: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job
cards.body: Some employers offer a Dependent Care FSA (a work account that lets you pay for childcare with pre-tax money). Check with your job to see whether yours does, and ask how long you have to sign up after your baby arrives.

sources.label: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job

cards.title: Federal Child Tax Credit (after birth)
cards.body: You are likely eligible for the federal Child Tax Credit, worth up to $2,200.00. You claim it on your yearly tax return.

cards.title: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit (after birth)
cards.body: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit: you are likely eligible. Worth $440.00.

sources.label: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit

cards.title: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave (after birth)
cards.body: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave: you are likely eligible. Going by your due date, plan to do this by about 2027-12-07. The date moves if your baby arrives early or late.

sources.label: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave

cards.title: Trump Account: $1,000 federal starter deposit (after birth)
cards.body: Your baby is likely eligible for a federal starter deposit of $1,000.00 in a Trump Account (a savings account opened after your baby arrives).
